title: Deleting Documents
subtitle: deleteOne, deleteMany, and safe deletion patterns

content.text: deleteOne() removes the first matching document. deleteMany() removes all matches. Both return a result with deletedCount.
Prefer soft deletes in production — set a deletedAt timestamp instead of removing the document.

questions.question: What does deleteMany({}) do?
options: Deletes all documents in the collection
questions.explanation: An empty filter {} matches every document, so deleteMany({}) removes them all.

faq.q: How do I drop an entire collection?
faq.a: Use collection.drop(). This removes all documents and indexes. This is irreversible.
